title: Veloso's mom in disbelief after Marcos' absolute pardon

blocks.text: CABANATUAN CITY – Mary Jane Veloso’s mother, better known as “Aling Celia,” had to be convinced by human rights lawyer Edre Olalia that her daughter might finally be free after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed documents granting her absolute pardon on Friday. “Ako man eh hindi ko mapaniwalaan nung tumawag si Atty. Edre dun pa lang ako ano… (I couldn’t believe the reports until Attorney Edre called, and that was the only time I was convinced),” Celia said. Former Nueva Ecija 3rd District Rep. Ria Vergara said she was happy about Marcos Jr.’s decision to pardon Veloso. On various occasions, Vergara […]... Keep on reading: Veloso's mom in disbelief after Marcos' absolute pardon
